delete.description: Requires an active device session. Password accounts must confirm their password and TOTP when enabled; external-only accounts must first complete a recent OIDC reauthentication tied to the current device session, then confirm their email and TOTP when enabled.

post.summary: Start OIDC reauthentication for account deletion
post.description: Requires an authenticated external-only account and matching X-Session-Id. Sets the OIDC state cookie and returns an authorization URL that forces provider login; successful callbacks reauthenticate the initiating session for 10 minutes.

403.description: Account does not support SSO reauthentication

post.summary: Exchange the one-time OIDC browser ticket for a Dashwise session

get.summary: List scoped API credentials for the authenticated account

200.description: Credential metadata. Raw token values are never listed.

post.summary: Create a read-only resource API credential
post.description: The raw bearer token is returned once. It is stored as a hash, expires within at most 365 days, and has only the resources:read scope.

201.description: Created credential and one-time token value.

token.description: Display once; never returned by list operations.

delete.summary: Revoke an API credential owned by the authenticated account
Revoke a device session and close its active connections

get.description: Returns public session metadata only; internal authentication credentials are never returned.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated session display name and returns public metadata only.

key.description: Stable key for the current condition.

activity.description: Required for operation upsert; omitted for clear.

post.description: Dismiss selected notification items from the inbox. An empty ids array dismisses all items for the authenticated user.

Accepts a scoped topic token in the path, or a topic ID with a Dashwise device-session bearer token. User/password Basic authentication is not supported. An optional expiresAt RFC 3339 timestamp on the envelope removes the notification after that time.
Accepts a Dashwise device-session token. Authorization headers take precedence over legacy body/query transports.

get.description: Upgrade this request to receive host statistics as JSON messages every three seconds when the stored sample changes. A token query parameter is supported for browser websocket clients.

source.description: Stable ID from the trusted SDK catalog.

config.description: Contribution selector values such as selected resource IDs.

capabilities.description: Generic capability tags used by app discovery such as monitoring.

bearerAuth.description: Dashwise device-session token or a scoped API credential. Scoped API credentials are accepted only by resource read endpoints.
